# VideoTile

**Class:** `UltraCanvasVideoTile` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVideoTile.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVideoTile.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasVideoTile.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Live pictures pushed frame by frame from any thread - a call's video, a self view (mirrored), a decoded stream; the newest frame shown, fitted (contain / cover), a caption without one

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasVideo](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasVideo.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasVideoTile(const std::string& identifier = "VideoTile", long x = 0, long y = 0, long w = 320, long h = 240);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `VideoTileFit`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Contain` | the whole picture, bars where the shapes differ |
| `Cover` | fills the tile, the overflow cut off (a call's main view) |

### enum `VideoTilePixelFormat`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `RGBA32` | bytes R, G, B, A |
| `BGRA32` | bytes B, G, R, A (what the camera backends deliver) |

### struct `Inbox`

What a frame-pushing thread and the UI thread share. A posted upload holds it, not the element: `owner` is cleared when the element goes.
